description: Immutable data object class for application user data in the Fineract project, including user attributes, roles, and related data collections.

classes.name: AppUserData
classes.description: Immutable data transfer object representing application user details, roles, and associated data within the Fineract system.

methods.name: importInstance
methods.description: Creates an AppUserData instance with provided user and role details for import purposes.

methods.name: template
methods.description: Generates a user template with specified user data and office options.

methods.name: dropdown
methods.description: Creates a minimal AppUserData instance for dropdown selection with id and username.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Creates a detailed AppUserData instance with full user attributes and roles.

methods.name: hasIdentifyOf
methods.description: Checks if the user has the specified identifier.

methods.name: username
methods.description: Returns the username of the user.

methods.name: setClients
methods.description: Associates a set of ClientData objects with the user.

methods.name: isSelfServiceUser
methods.description: Indicates whether the user is a self-service user.
